# Copyright (c) 2024 Analog Devices, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description: |
  Analog Devices LTC2959 Ultra-Low Power Battery Gas Gauge

compatible: "adi,ltc2959"

include: [i2c-device.yaml]

properties:
  rsense-milliohms:
    type: int
    required: true
    description: |
      Sense resistor value in milliohms.

  prescaler-m:
    type: int
    default: 1024
    description: |
      Coulomb counter prescaler M value.

  alcc-pin-mode:
    type: string
    default: "disabled"
    enum:
      - "disabled"
      - "alert"
      - "charge-complete"
    description: |
      Configuration for the ALCC pin.
